g.aria-label: Step 1: Linearize Score Sₙ(θ̂) = 0 Around True θ*
Step 2: Apply CLT to Numerator & LLN to Denominator
Numerator Sₙ(θ*)/√n → N(0, I(θ*)) (CLT) | Denominator −Sₙ'(θ*)/n → I(θ*) (LLN)
Step 3: Ratio Variance I(θ*) / I(θ*)² = I(θ*)⁻¹
√n (θ̂ − θ*) →ᵈ N( 0, I(θ*)⁻¹ ) ⇒ Var(θ̂) ≈ (n I(θ*))⁻¹ (Cramér–Rao Optimal)
